== English Anthology family comparison ==
The published Endor wording explicitly limits deployment to once per deploy phase. Decipher's Special Edition Glossary already limited an action tied to a phase and worded as 'one' to a single use in that phase. The revised card spells out that limit. Both printed faces retain the war-room condition, all-system destiny modifier, the non-unique Rebels' forfeit, and the non-unique Rebel deployment from Reserve Deck. Decipher's later senator characteristic ruling remains a separate rule.
